description: A Git client inside VS Code: commit graph, branches, staging by hunk or line, a merge dialog for conflicts and interactive rebase.
config.maxCommits: How many commits are loaded at a time. Scrolling to the end of the list loads the next batch.
config.gravatar: Show Gravatar pictures for commit authors. Off by default: it sends a hash of each author email address to gravatar.com. Without it, Bonsai shows initials. Takes effect when Bonsai is reopened.
